title: SelectPFN: Amortized Bayesian Variable Selection for Sparse Nonlinear Regression with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.21950v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tabular foundation models based on prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) predict on a new data set in a single forward pass, but they cannot report which inputs their predictions depend on. We propose SelectPFN, a PFN that performs Bayesian variable selection and prediction jointly for sparse nonlinear regression. In one forward pass it returns posterior inclusion probabilities for every variable, and its predictions are computed from sampled subsets only, so excluded variables provably cannot affect them; we show this is exactly what the Bayesian model prescribes. The network is pretrained once on synthetic tasks from a meta-prior built around a group spike-and-slab sparse-input neural network. Column-permutation equivariance combined with random interleaving of original and knockoff columns yields knockoff statistics with exact finite-sample false discovery rate control, even when the meta-prior is wrong. translated_title: SelectPFN：基于先验数据拟合网络的稀疏非线性回归摊销贝叶斯变量选择
translated_abstract: 基于先验数据拟合网络（PFNs）的表格基础模型可以在单次前向传播中对新数据集进行预测，但它们无法报告其预测依赖于哪些输入。我们提出SelectPFN，这是一种为稀疏非线性回归联合执行贝叶斯变量选择和预测的PFN。在一次前向传播中，它返回每个变量的后验包含概率，且其预测仅从采样的变量子集计算得出，因此被排除的变量可证明无法影响预测；我们证明这正是贝叶斯模型所规定的结果。该网络基于围绕组尖峰-平板稀疏输入神经网络构建的元先验，在合成任务上进行一次性预训练。列置换等变性结合原始列与敲除列的随机交错，产生了具有精确有限样本错误发现率控制的敲除统计量，即使元先验不准确时依然成立。我们为摊销式方法建立了相应的理论。
tldr: SelectPFN是一种在单次前向传播中同时完成稀疏非线性回归贝叶斯变量选择与预测的先验数据拟合网络，可输出每个变量的后验包含概率，并通过敲除列实现精确的有限样本错误发现率控制。
en_tdlr: SelectPFN is a prior-data fitted network that jointly performs Bayesian variable selection and prediction for sparse nonlinear regression in a single forward pass, providing posterior inclusion probabilities for every variable and exact finite-sample false discovery rate control via knockoff columns.
